title: Blueberry cake near Rydalmere or Ermington? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Looking for a blueberry cake near Rydalmere or Ermington that has no eggs in it at all? Harris Park makes one.

Every cake at Num Nums is 100% eggless, which is why a family that avoids eggs for faith or allergy reasons never has to ask. The blueberry sponge stays soft for days because the base uses oil, not butter. Six sizes from 6 inch ($39.99, serves 6-8) to 16 inch, in buttercream, fondant or ganache.

Order two days ahead. Pickup from Wigram Street, a short drive from Parramatta CBD, open 11am to 10pm daily. It's called eggless. It doesn't taste like it.

WhatsApp +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati.
